summary: Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-118747 - .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability
details: ## Executive summary Microsoft is releasing this security advisory to provide information about a vulnerability in .NET. This advisory provides guidance on updating affected applications and components. Colliding CBOR map keys can hash-flood uniqueness checks; the fix uses seeded Marvin hashing. ## Announcement Announcement for this issue can be found at https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/501 ## CVSS Details - **Version:** 3.1 - **Severity:** High - **Score:** 7.5 (base score) - **Vector:** `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H/E:U/RL:O/RC:C` - **Weakness:** CWE-407 ## Affected Platforms - **Platforms:** Any supported OS - **Architectures:** All ## Affected Packages The tables list affected package versions and fixed versions. These are independently versioned NuGet packages, not runtime patch versions. ### 8.0 - standalone packages Package | Affected version | Patched version --- | --- | --- [System.Formats.Cbor](https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Formats.Cbor) | >= 8.0.0-0, < 8.0.2 | 8.0.2 ### 9.0 - standalone packages Package | Affected version | Patched version --- | --- | --- [System.Formats.Cbor](https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Formats.Cbor) | >= 9.0.0-0, < 9.0.24 | 9.0.24 Update 9.0 applications to System.Formats.Cbor 9.0.24; 9.0.23 is not a fix. The fixed 10.0.15 package, which includes a net9.0 target, remains an alternative. ### 10.0 - standalone packages Package | Affected version | Patched version --- | --- | --- [System.Formats.Cbor](https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Formats.Cbor) | >= 10.0.0-0, < 10.0.15 | 10.0.15 ### 11.0 - standalone packages Package | Affected version | Patched version --- | --- | --- [System.Formats.Cbor](https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Formats.Cbor) | >= 11.0.0-0, < 11.0.0 | 11.0.0 ## Advisory FAQ ### How do I know if I am affected? Check the application's System.Formats.Cbor package reference against the affected ranges above. Updating only the installed runtime does not update this independently referenced package. ### How do I fix the issue? Update each applicable package reference to its patched version listed above, then rebuild and redeploy the application. Updating only the installed runtime does not update an application's standalone package references. ## Other Information ### Reporting Security Issues If you have found a potential security issue in a supported version of .NET, please report it to the Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) via the [MSRC Researcher Portal](https://msrc.microsoft.com/report/vulnerability/new). Further information can be found in the MSRC [Report an Issue FAQ](https://www.microsoft.com/msrc/faqs-report-an-issue). Security reports made through MSRC may qualify for the Microsoft .NET Bounty. Details of the Microsoft .NET Bounty Program including terms and conditions are at https://aka.ms/corebounty. ### Support You can ask questions about this issue on GitHub in the .NET GitHub organization. The main repos are located at https://github.com/dotnet/runtime. The Announcements repo (https://github.com/dotnet/Announcements) will contain this bulletin as an issue and will include a link to a discussion issue. You can ask questions in the linked discussion issue. ### Disclaimer The information provided in this advisory is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind.
